message.content:
This appears to be from a CBP ruling or a Commerce scope ruling on herbal tinctures. Vegetable extracts fall under heading 1302 ("vegetable saps and extracts"), subheading 1302.19 for other extracts. The 1302.19 subheadings are:

- 1302.19.05: Medicinal vegetable saps and extracts, of vegetable origin
- 1302.19.40: Other (various)
- 1302.19.91: Other

Alternatively, these could be classified under 3004 as medicaments if put up in measured doses or retail packing for therapeutic use, but the description covers only the bulk extract, so heading 1302 applies.

Within 1302.19, I recall 1302.19.4100 for "Other: Other" and 1302.19.9100 for others. The extracts are medicinal in nature, so the best fit is 1302.19.91 or 1302.19.40. Checking the structure: 1302.19.05 is "Containing alcohol…", while 1302.19.10 covers "Ginseng extracts", 1302.19.15 other pharmaceutical use, 1302.19.20 and later cover other uses. Of these, 1302.19.91 is likely the general residual and the tincture is not alcoholic, so I choose 1302.19.9100.
